narr: Thunderstorms produced between 4 and 6 inches of rainfall leading to flooding across southeastern Kansas.
ev: Numerous streets around Columbus along with several other rural roads around the county were flooded.
Street flooding was reported on 580th and 260th Avenues.
Water was over the road on 200th Avenue south of Highway 126.
Numerous city streets were reported flooded.
A vehicle was reported stranded in high water 2 miles south of Mulberry.
